name: Erin Ivie
occupation: Fremont County coroner (appointed November 1, 2022; elected November 2026)
education: Bachelor's degree in criminal justice with a minor in crime scene investigation/forensic science, 2011 (official coroner page)
prior_offices: Fremont County coroner (the official coroner page states she was appointed deputy coroner in 2003 and appointed coroner on November 1, 2022; she was elected in 2026).
background: Erin Ivie is the Fremont County coroner and was elected in the November 2026 general election. The official coroner page states that she was appointed a deputy coroner in 2003, completed a bachelor's degree in criminal justice with a minor in crime scene investigation/forensic science in 2011, is nationally certified as a medicolegal death investigator by the American Board of Medicolegal Death Investigators, is a member of several professional forensic organizations, is recognized by Wyoming Peace Officer Standards and Training as a general lecturer and teaches regularly at the Wyoming Law Enforcement Academy, serves as a medicolegal death investigator for the Region 8 Disaster Mortuary Operational Response Team, has more than 1,700 hours of training in the field, and was appointed Fremont County coroner on November 1, 2022. She was unopposed in the 2026 primary and general elections.
